principle: Core child safety must operate with zero Wi-Fi dependency.

device_runtime.Gekyume: pre-movement governance pattern adapted to location/data release
device_runtime.local_AI: speech, map retrieval, child guidance; evidence only, never final authority

validation_factory.ProofGate_AI: candidate release gate and durable receipt
validation_factory.AWS_Braket_IBM_Qiskit: experimental witness branches; never child-runtime dependencies
validation_factory.Sharingan_patterns: generic evidence reconciliation/contradiction handling only; no sports domain data

cloud_control_plane.DynamoDB: device manifests, authority, receipts, release state
cloud_control_plane.API_Gateway: controlled cloud APIs; never required by core device loop

prohibited_dependencies: cloud model for local safety decision
